V: Cervical radiculopathy: Numbness and tingling in the arm may be due to nerve root compression in the cervical spine.
I: Multiple sclerosis: Symptoms of numbness, tingling, and transient visual disturbances could indicate MS.

supporting_evidence: Numbness and tingling in the left arm.
Transient loss of peripheral vision in the left eye.
